docs.snippet:
Arclin Manufacturing - Demand Planning
Blueprint Workshop Notes
Client Overview
Client Name: Arclin Manufacturing Inc.
Industry: Specialty Chemicals Manufacturing
Headquarters: Georgia, USA
ERP System: SAP S/4HANA
Current Planning Tool: Excel-based planning process
Project Objective: Implement Kinaxis RapidResponse for Demand Planning, Supply Planning, and
Inventory Optimization.
Current Challenges
Demand planners spend significant time consolidating forecasts from multiple regions.
Forecast accuracy is approximately 68%.
No centralized planning platform exists across North America and Europe.

docs.doc_name: Arclin Manufacturing - Demand Planning Blueprint Workshop Notes.pdf
docs.snippet:
Demand Planning Requirements
Forecast Management
Generate statistical baseline forecasts.
Support forecast overrides by planners.
Track forecast history and changes.
Support multiple forecast hierarchies.
Collaboration
Allow sales teams to provide forecast input.
Enable approval workflows.
Provide forecast comparison reports.
Analytics
Measure Forecast Accuracy.
Measure Forecast Bias.
Track MAPE by product family.
Provide dashboard-based reporting.
Supply Planning Requirements
Generate constrained supply plans.
Identify material shortages.
Support capacity planning.

docs.doc_name: Arclin Manufacturing - Demand Planning Blueprint Workshop Notes.pdf
docs.snippet:
Required Interfaces:
Product Master
Customer Master
Sales Orders
Inventory Balances
Purchase Orders
Production Orders
Data Refresh Frequency:
Every 4 hours
Success Criteria
Forecast Accuracy > 85%
Inventory Reduction > 15%
Planning Cycle Reduction > 30%
Improved Planner Productivity
Single Source of Planning Data
Workshop Notes
Business users emphasized the need for collaborative forecasting and visibility across regions.
Demand planners requested automated forecast generation with the ability to manually override
forecasts when market conditions change.
